name: gfr-chapter-6-lookup
description: GFR 2017 Chapter 6 (Procurement of Goods and Services, Rules 142-206) verbatim lookup. Use for any question about procurement rules, thresholds, tender procedures, bid security, performance security, purchase committees, GeM, consulting services or outsourcing of services.

operations.summary: Search all 67 rules of Chapter 6 by keyword, ranked
operations.returns: Ranked array of {score, rule, title, part, doc, api}

operations.summary: Get one rule in full: verbatim text, Hinglish explanation, sub-rules, provisos, notes, exceptions, amendment footnotes

id.description: Rule number: 155, 172(1), 175(2), 206. Parentheses may be URL-encoded or hyphenated.

operations.returns: {rule, title, part, verbatim, hinglish, sub_rules[], provisos[], notes[], exceptions[], footnotes[]}

operations.summary: List every sub-rule, proviso, note, exception and footnote, optionally for one rule
Corpus totals: rules, sub-rules, provisos, notes, exceptions, footnotes

usage_notes: Always call gfr_search first when the user does not give a rule number.
Then call gfr_get_rule with the rule number to quote the verbatim text.
Quote the verbatim field exactly. Do not paraphrase thresholds, time limits or authorities.
Read the footnotes array before answering a question about a threshold - the 10.07.2024 amendment (OM No. F.1/3/2024-PPD) changed Rules 149, 155, 161, 162, 173(xxii), 183 and 201.
Rule 144(x) restricts bidders from countries sharing a land border on defence-of-India / national-security grounds (OM No. F.7/10/2021-PPD dated 23.02.2023).
Rule 206 says circumstances not covered by Rules 198-205 fall back to Rules 142-176 (goods), NOT the consulting-services rules.
The hinglish field is a plain-language explanation in Hindi-English mix. Use it to explain, not to quote.
